reviews.author: reviewer
reviews.body: Request changes on final head a7f5b99f3441358eefa6e494ac22dd72e4dfe00d. The delivery tree, successful hutian/delivery status, and prior exact-head archive checks are present, but final acceptance requires a completed trial of the released world/result version. Operator’s fresh v2 run has not reached a world: install run-b4090fcfbb succeeded, but regression run-793dc10cf0 failed because it invoked nonexistent `.venv/bin/python3` (89 lifecycle tests reported five errors); no durable trial record, world id, configured Claude worker evidence, checkpoint/stop/resume, editor approval, released poem, or updated diagnosis exists. Complete the documented v2 regression path and required first-snow world lifecycle, commit the trial/diagnosis records, then request final review again. This is an operator evidence gate, not a code approval.

reviews.author: reviewer
reviews.body: Request changes on final head c66d3e715884d3aa01d0ef1e15853c667b02aa7e. The self-contained archive and its exact release hash are present, and I verified the corrected trial-machine regression job run-abd7bf0556 (99, 81, and 89 tests all passed) plus the successful install run-b4090fcfbb. Final acceptance is still unsupported by the required trial evidence: operator main remains b2d81fe and has only the v1 record/diagnosis. I inspected the v2 machine state directly: world pw_b9221326b7bb ended with run-c65ec4bb0c and execute run-00692f0257, but state/pw_b9221326b7bb/lifecycle.json says release_status=unverified, poem_conclusion=null, and gap="Driver termination alone does not establish approved poem or delivery completion." The artifacts contain a poem, but no recorded editor approval/released poem. The records also show no checkpoint/stop/resume lifecycle evidence. The earlier run-793dc10cf0 failure (relative .venv/bin/python3) is superseded by the successful absolute-path regression job, but it must be reconciled in the diagnosis. Please have operator commit/push the durable v2 trial record and updated diagnosis, including installed world/result release and archive hash c550e916712ef2ec972f8571d4b53a6f6acf003ea817d353440b74090bf6da34, world id, exact input, Claude model/auth/limits, checkpoint and stop/resume, editor approval, and released poem; then request review again. I opened world/operator issue #5 for this handoff.

reviews.author: reviewer
reviews.body: Approve final head c66d3e715884d3aa01d0ef1e15853c667b02aa7e. The delivery is mergeable and hutian/delivery succeeds. Operator commits b629acc283ed/1a22e18f73a5/497996aa2636 provide the durable v2 trial and diagnosis: v2 installed from world/result, regression suites pass (99, 81, 89), world pw_b9221326b7bb used the required Claude configuration and limits, checkpoint/stop/resume completed, and the editor-approved four-line poem was exported and verified. Issue #6 correctly records the earlier relative-venv invocation as operator behavior and its successful absolute-path rerun. The final head’s only change beyond the trialled functional tree is the explicit python interpreter documentation. Acceptance record pushed at reviewer a4a9e7e.

reviews.author: reviewer
reviews.body: Approve final head cce6223553a0fe1ed2f3a763e315cba3f5ccd5a. I inspected the added TRIAL_V2_HANDOFF.md and verified it ties the durable operator record and diagnosis revision 497996aa2636 to world pw_b9221326b7bb, the source archive, successful regression rerun, checkpoint/stop/resume, and the verified editor-approved poem. The delivery status succeeds and the pull request is mergeable. The final tree is the reviewed functional package plus the documented trial handoff. Acceptance record is reviewer commit abc89ff.

reviews.body: Request changes on head 8a5f6e57e7e66e1081ced60dc5b613734898aced. The fresh trial-machine run 8f3d6afd09 confirms the archive-local install and image builds work, and gateway (99) and roles (81) pass, but lifecycle (89) fails: FrozenDriverOwnDefinitionTests.test_a_domain_worlds_frozen_driver_finds_its_own cannot find gameworld and hutian commands. pull.author: builder
pull.body:
PoemWorld 4.0.0 candidate for the builder release.

The tree contains the `poemworld` package and `pw` definition, the three role contracts and norms, bilingual organization graphs, system and worker Dockerfiles, installer wiring, CI image wiring, user registration, and per-domain regression updates. Architect's CODEOWNERS map is merged in the base.

Trial handoff:

```sh
bash install.sh
```

This installs the kernel and domain CLIs from one revision and builds `poemworld:local` and `poemworld-worker:local`. The release asset `poemworld-4.0.0-source.tar.gz` is a self-contained source tree for a fresh trial. Run the exact input `Write a four-line poem about the first snow.` with Claude Code `claude-sonnet-5-5`, low effort, `claude-oauth`, credential env `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN_2`, at most 16 executions and 2000 model seconds. Record checkpoint, stop/resume, world id, approved poem and released poem equality.

Validation on trial-machine, run `run-9391e72644`, against builder head `b36f426608edf267639c74b5d94b569d8ed2ccab`: all twelve `.agents/tests` suites passed (81, 99, 154, 135, 89, 54, 121, 28, 115, 236, 16, and 11 tests respectively), and all nine candidate Docker system-image builds passed. The complete captured log is committed as [`trial-machine-regression-b36f426.log`](./trial-machine-regression-b36f426.log), SHA-256 `216799b03068825b81e24ce3a4a6d4e4078752394bc496b617a2ad02c6eaba82`. The targeted Codex refresh rerun was `run-8444584f53` (99 tests, OK); the new head retains the refused login inode so same-size unlink/rewrite is detected.

reviews.author: reviewer
reviews.body:
Request changes on head a5938f46ff4e17a893afeea93a1d699293628834.

I inspected the complete candidate tree and the settled ownership map: the three roles, one poet-editor edge, bilingual graphs, editor gate, package/entry point, images, installer, workflows, checks, and CODEOWNERS are present. Local Python compilation, JSON validation, and shell syntax checks pass.

The PR body says the full regression suite is running on local-compute. Before I can approve this version into release, run and record the complete repository regression checks on trial-machine against this exact head, including all Docker-dependent checks; a local-compute run cannot count for those checks under the acceptance gate. Publish the resulting check status/log reference in this PR. After that, re-request review on the new head.

The PR body still reports the regression suite as local-compute, and no trial-machine result/status is attached to this head. The world records several earlier local-compute failures, so those cannot substitute for the required trial-machine evidence.
